title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
description:

Complications arise after the birth of Talbert the giraffe; Robert rescues a black swan entangled in fishing line; Bindi and Chandler plan for Kingston the rhino's first birthday.

title: Animal Cribs
description:

title: Animal Cribs
description:

The team transforms a hazardous backyard into a dog-friendly escape; a bathroom transforms into a dog wash and feeding station.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S11 E08 — Under the Radar
Officer Canfield breaks up a 45-year-old illegal fishing tournament; Officer MacFadden rescues an injured hawk; Officer Hannett confronts two kids riding OHRVs on the road; on Mt. Chocorua, officers rescue a woman with a fractured ankle.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S03 E08 — Lost and Found
Search and rescue training for a new class of wardens; hiker vanishes on the Appalachian Trail.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S11 E02 — Schoolyard Bear
Officer Chris McKee attempts to remove a bear from a tree in a playground; Officer Fluette picks out his new K-9 partner; Officer Lucas searches for a group of ATVs; on the snowy summit of Mount Washington, officers search for lost hikers.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S11 E06 — Don't Feed the Bears
Officer Joe Canfield investigates a home with multiple bear feeding complaints and finds more than he bargained for; Officer Egan investigates an abandoned car and missing persons case; officers respond to a drowning in the Connecticut River.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S11 E03 — No Trespassing
Lt. Boudreau and Officer Hannett investigate a possible illegal turkey kill site; Officer Bronson responds to a call about a snake in a bed; Officer Demler confronts a suspect about shooting a turkey on private property.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S11 E09 — Shakedown
Sgt. Hawks and Officer Benvenuti supervise Trainee Frye's lobster trap detail; Officer Lucas and Trainee McDermott deal with a woman illegally keeping a wild squirrel; Officer Delisle and Biologist Marchand investigate the deaths of multiple turtles.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S03 E10 — Uncuffed 2
Highlighting the best of the last two seasons; North Woods Law Day is celebrated at a baseball game.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S11 E04 — Turkey Trouble
Lt. Boudreau, K-9 Ruby and Officer MacFadden investigate a hunter suspected of shooting a turkey from the road; Officer McKee searches for a baby owl that fell from its nest; Officer Hannett rushes to lead a carry-out when a hiker suffers an injury.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S11 E07 — Coastal Criminals
Officer James Benvenuti chases down two lobster poachers in Rye; Officer Graham Courtney investigates a man on the beach found covered in blood; Sergeant Adam Cheney attempts to apprehend trespassers on the railroad tracks.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S11 E05 — Spring Training
Officer Lucas sends a trainee to wrangle his first angry raccoon; Officer Fluette untangles a trapper's web of lies; Officer Benvenuti tries to rescue an injured gosling; Officers Boudreau and Hannett question father and son turkey hunters.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S03 E06 — Drunk Hunting
Suspicious shotgun blasts on Catahoula Lake lead wildlife agents on a high-speed chase; a trail of beer cans points to a pair of hunters with multiple violations; on the bayou, agents catch a lawbreaking crawfisherman.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S03 E03 — Guns and Meth
When a child is thrown from a boat and badly injured, wildlife agents are first on the scene; a night hunter faces multiple felony charges when agents make a grave discovery, agents confront a jet ski rider who risks drowning and gets belligerent.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S03 E07 — Backroads Outlaw
A suspicious driver leads wildlife agents on a high-speed chase through a national forest; goose-hunting guides are caught in a repeat offense; a routine stop turns treacherous when a suspect is discovered concealing a firearm.

title: Louisiana Law
description:

A bizarre discovery inside an abandoned cooler escalates a littering probe; wildlife agents patrolling in dense fog are thrown into a dangerous encounter, and a burglary investigation uncovers an illegally taken deer.

title: Louisiana Law
description:

When a pair of illegal hunters flee by truck, wildlife agents set out to track them down; heaps of trash dumped at a fishing spot lead to a suspect who denies any wrongdoing; damning evidence in a truck bed catches a hunter in a lie.

title: Louisiana Law
description:

Cornish Rex kittens attempt to befriend an iguana; a tortoiseshell cat raises disparate twin boys; a Birman cat hopes her kittens will follow in her regal footsteps.

title: Too Cute!
description:

Calico kittens mingle with the patrons of a dog-grooming salon; shorthairs get into mischief; two tabbies frolic in the outdoors.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S03 E04 — Vegan Cowboys
Tensions run high when Dr. Blue visits a cattle ranch to castrate five adult bulls; Dr. Ross treats a hen with an injury; a puppy needs a serious surgery after being hit by a car.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S03 E08 — Wedding Day Blues
Dr. Blue surprises his wife with a romantic wedding vow renewal in Las Vegas; a Schnauzer being boarded at the clinic needs medical help from Dr. Lavigne; Dr. Ross treats a very ornery parrot; a senior dog with a recurring eye mass.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S02 E08 — Tuskegee Reunion
The doctors visit their alma mater for a class reunion and become professors for a day; a shih tzu is rushed to the clinic after swallowing a large piece of rawhide, while the owner of a pit bull with a deformed leg must consider drastic surgery.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S04 E01 — The Pig Whisperers
A pit bull suffers a raccoon attack; an aggressive ferret; the vets test their pig-whispering skills at an animal rescue; the doctors have a surprise announcement for their wives.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S07 E08 — Loves Bites!
Ambreen has been in an abusive relationship for the past 13 years, but her abuser is her cat, Calvin; Josh has two women in his life--his cat Nico and his girlfriend, who recently moved in with them. But Nico has been anything but welcoming.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S07 E10 — Paranormal Cat-tivity
A woman creates a video as a desperate plea for help to find her ferocious feline a new home; a couple has three cats who viciously attack one another while treating the home as their personal litter box.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S07 E07 — Happily Never After
When Debbie returns home from a trip, she finds her house covered and smelling like cat pee from her boyfriend, Brian's cat Blinkie, who denies the problem; Krisi may have to choose between marriage to her boyfriend Jason and her cat Frankie.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S15 E07 — Taste of Their Own Medicine
For the first time ever, two Naked and Afraid crew members attempt to survive 21 days in front of the camera. But faced with swarms of unrelenting insects and a lack of food, this history-making duo is about to get a taste of their own medicine.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S15 E08 — Beauty and the Beasties
An expert hunter and an Air Force veteran attempt to survive in Zambia, where they are preyed upon by deadly lions, aggressive baboons and elephants.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S15 E11 — Cry for Me, Argentina
Rachel, a survivalist from "Naked and Afraid of Love," and Na'im, an outdoorsman from Colorado, take on 21 days in the rugged wilderness of Argentina, but freezing nighttime temperatures may push them to their limit.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S16 E01 — Blood and Money
An ICU nurse and a banker attempt a 14-day fan challenge in the rugged Mexican jungle; as food becomes scarce, they question their will and skill to make it to the end.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S15 E10 — Not Today, Satan
Two survivalists attempt to endure 21 days in Mexico's Devil's Canyon, a notorious hellscape where no one else has managed to make it past one week.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S18 E10 — Mayan Blood Sacrifice
In Mexico, four survivalists attempt to endure 21 days in the ancient Mayan jungle, where humans were once sacrificed to the gods; battling relentless mosquitoes, torrential storms and stinging wasps, the two teams must merge into a tribe to survive.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S18 E07 — Enter the Queen
"Naked and Afraid" legend Laura Zerra returns to mentor a blacksmith and a former MMA fighter as they attempt to survive 21 days in Yucatán; scant food resources, deadly crocodiles and violent storms shake their confidence.

description:

title: Swamp Wars
description:

The Venom One team races to contain a 400-pound alligator, angry crocodiles and poisonous snakes.

description:
S01 E08 — The Dodo of the North
Forrest travels to the Faroe Islands to look for any trace of the great auk; his passionate search for a large flightless seabird takes him through some of the most scenic and rugged terrain he's ever seen.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S01 E05 — The Javan Tiger
Forrest Galante visits the island of Java in Indonesia to look for the Javan Tiger; this exotic predator was declared extinct in 2003, but park rangers and locals have had recent sightings and are collecting evidence of its existence.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S01 E02 — The Madagascar Giant
Madagascar's Pachylemurs were red, furry giants, nearly the size of great apes; recently discovered remains disprove that they went extinct 1,000 years ago; Forrest tries to prove the giant species still lives.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S01 E04 — Florida Black Panther
Forrest combs the Florida Everglades for a predator rumored to exist for years, the Black Panther; it might be a case of mistaken identity, but while scouring the landscape, discoveries suggest that it might be more than a rumor.

title: River Monsters
description:
S04 E05 — Russian Killer
Jeremy travels to the Amur River in eastern Russia, where a mammoth predator is allegedly responsible for the disappearances of three fishermen.

title: River Monsters
description:

Jeremy searches for a monstrous beast that reportedly lives in the Zambezi River and can swallow children whole.

The African penguin colony greets its newest additions after a successful mating season; sea otter Mara is presented to the rest of the raft, and the bottlenose dolphin population in Florida is examined.

The team is eager to open their new alligator exhibit featuring rare albino gators; sea otter Gibson is tested for a possible infection; divers must swim with Taroko the whale shark to get a blood sample.

Aquarium staff travel to the remote island of St. Helena to gain footage of whale sharks in their natural habitat during mating season; a spotted ribbontail ray is introduced to her new tank friends, and Cerbie the seal is treated for joint pain.

description:

title: Tanked
description:

The team works its magic on a photo booth and constructs an underwater wonderland in a wing of an Ohio children's hospital.

title: Tanked

Wayde and Brett are challenged by a Southern California resort to build a tank inside the trunk of an oak tree; a Halloween store wants a coffin aquarium.

title: Tanked
description:

Revisiting tanks Wayde and Brett have created for celebrities, including comic Tracy Morgan, actor Neil Patrick Harris and rock band Kiss.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S03 E09 — Canopy Island Camp
Pete is tasked with building a tree-top, Native American themed, summer camp treehouse with a built-in kennel, French door, climbing wall, back deck and fire pole for a young family on the Washington coast.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S03 E03 — Bionic Treehouse
Pete returns to where he built his very first treehouse; now with experience, knowledge, new techniques and some steel, he can rebuild it; he has the technology; he has the capability to build the world's first bionic treehouse.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S03 E11 — Country Superstar Speakeasy
Pete builds a secluded, three-story, speakeasy-themed treehouse, 60 feet above the ground with rooftop lounge and writing-and-recording room with vintage guitars for country music superstar Brian Kelley, of the award-winning duo Florida Georgia Line.
